findings.summary: has_analytics is enforced client-side only. The analytics data query goes directly from the browser to Supabase via the anon client with no server-side plan check. Free-plan vendors can read print_jobs by calling Supabase directly.
findings.action: Add a server-side check (API route or Supabase RLS policy) that blocks print_jobs queries for shops whose active plan has has_analytics = false.

findings.summary: has_whatsapp_bot and has_custom_poster only suppress sidebar UI elements. No WhatsApp or custom-poster API route calls getShopActivePlan before serving requests.
findings.action: If /api/whatsapp and any poster-generation routes exist, add a getShopActivePlan check and return 403 when the flag is false.

findings.summary: Both idempotency checks in subscriptionService.js (wallet_transactions description LIKE scan and subscriptions.payment_id lookup) degrade to 'proceed' on any DB error. A transient Supabase failure during the duplicate-check window lets a replayed callback re-extend a subscription. The wallet_transactions scan is also an unindexed full-table scan.
findings.action: Promote subscriptions.payment_id as the primary idempotency key. Only proceed (fail-open) when the DB check itself errors; if the check returns an empty result, that is a new payment and is safe to apply.

findings.summary: subscription_expires_at = NULL on a paid plan grants permanent access. This is deliberate but there is no admin UI indicator, no is_admin_granted flag, and no audit log entry to distinguish manual grants from billing-system-issued subscriptions.
findings.action: Add an is_admin_granted column or admin UI label so support staff can identify and audit shops with permanent plan access.
